name: ui-click
text: a single crisp tactile click of a mouse button, close, dry, no reverb

name: card-thunk
text: a stiff cardboard card set down flat on a wooden table, soft thud, close, dry

name: card-slide
text: a paper card sliding quickly across a smooth table, short, dry

name: whoosh
text: a short dry whoosh, fast air movement past the microphone, no reverb tail

name: counter-tick
text: a single small mechanical counter tick, very short, dry

name: stamp
text: a rubber stamp pressed hard onto paper on a desk, one firm thud, dry

name: haptic
text: a smartphone vibrating once on a wooden desk, short buzz

name: notify
text: a soft generic two-note notification chime, gentle, not a phone brand sound

name: typing
text: a short burst of quiet laptop keyboard typing, five or six keys, close

name: tab-click
text: a light dry click of a browser tab being clicked, very short

name: low-hit
text: one deep soft low impact hit, short, tight, no boom tail
